info.title: polygraph
info.description: Independent A–F behavioral trust grades for MCP servers. Hosted grading is discontinued; published grades remain available via the lookup API. To grade a server yourself, run the open harness.

post.description: Returns 410 Gone. Operator-run hosted grading is no longer offered. Existing published grades remain available. To grade a server yourself, run the open harness: npx -y -p @polygraphso/litmus polygraphso-litmus litmus <server>.

server_ref.description: Target to grade: npm ref (npm/@scope/name), github/owner/repo, pypi/name, or an https:// MCP URL.

email.description: Optional email notified when the grade publishes.

agent_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the requesting agent.
